thesis.thesis: PRELIMINARY / PRICE-ONLY. Over the five daily bars retrieved from Nasdaq for AMD (2026-10-14 through 2026-10-20), the close moved from 570.82 to 534.74, a change of -36.08 in price units, or -6.32% (computed as (534.74 - 570.82) / 570.82). Direction is negative: the latest close is below the first close. This is a descriptive observation of a single short window, not a fundamental thesis. No earnings, revenue, margin, valuation, competitive, or forward-catalyst evidence has been retrieved or verified, so no view on AMD's business trajectory or intrinsic value is asserted. Conviction is set to 1 to reflect that the only verified input is a five-bar price series.
assumptions: The five Nasdaq daily bars retrieved are accurate and complete for the stated dates.
Closes are treated as unadjusted as returned by the source; no split/dividend adjustment was verified.

Evidence that the retrieved window is not a contiguous set of trading days.

message.content:
**Thesis saved once** — `th_847e75c081d34171ad98`, version 1, status `researching`, conviction 1.

## Computed change (from the retrieved bars only)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| First bar | 2026-10-14, close **570.82** |
| Latest bar | 2026-10-20, close **534.74** |
| Absolute change | **−36.08** price units |
| Percent change | **−6.32%** — `(534.74 − 570.82) / 570.82 = −0.063207` |
| Direction | **Negative** (latest close below first close) |

Adjacent closes were checked before any day-to-day statement, and the path is **not** monotonic: down 8.59 (10-14→10-15), down 33.48 (10-15→10-16), **up 9.30** (10-16→10-19), down 3.31 (10-19→10-20). So the net −6.32% is a first-to-latest comparison, not a steady decline. I've omitted any trend, momentum, or "sell-off" characterization since it isn't needed for the bounded conclusion.

## What this window can and cannot establish

**Can establish:** the two endpoint closes and the arithmetic difference between them; that the latest close in this window is lower than the first; that the path included at least one up day; that the window covers five trading days (2026-10-17/18 absent as a weekend).

**Cannot establish:** any trend or regime (five bars is far too short); whether the move is meaningful versus normal volatility (no baseline dispersion computed); earnings, revenue, margins, or guidance; valuation; competitive position; forward catalysts; split/dividend adjustment basis; or currency — the source output contained **no currency field**, so USD is recorded as an unverified assumption rather than a fact.

## Saved evidence fields
Source name **Nasdaq**; source URL `https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/AMD/historical?assetclass=stocks&limit=5000&fromdate=2026-10-01&todate=2026-10-21`; interval `1d` (one bar per trading day); first/latest bar dates and closes as above; currency flagged unreported; plus an explicit `not_verified` list covering earnings, valuation, forward catalysts, and SEC filings.

Two caveats recorded in the thesis: the `5d` request returned the last five rows of a URL range spanning 2026-10-01→2026-10-21, and no SEC data was retrieved, so none is cited. No alerts created, no portfolio changes, no trade recommendation.
